resources.title: Day 1 in Valheim: What You NEED To Do First
resources.creator: Kysen
resources.noteEs: Kysen condensa en 7 minutos lo crítico del primer día: priorizar el club, dormir antes de la noche, no luchar contra trolls en stone gear. Tono pedagógico claro, ideal como primer video que ves antes de empezar.
resources.noteEn: Kysen condenses the critical first-day moves into 7 minutes: prioritize the club, sleep before night, don't fight trolls in stone gear. Clear pedagogical tone, ideal as the first video you watch before starting.

resources.title: Your Ultimate Beginner's Guide to Valheim – 20 Essential Tips to Survive in 2025
resources.creator: ENJOYJONBOY
resources.noteEs: 20 tips concretos para sobrevivir las primeras horas: stamina management, comida, mecánicas escondidas. Pace rápido, sin relleno. Apunta a quien ya jugó algo de survival pero arranca Valheim por primera vez.
resources.noteEn: 20 concrete tips for surviving the first hours: stamina management, food, hidden mechanics. Fast pace, no fluff. Targets someone who's played survival games before but is new to Valheim.

resources.title: Watch Before Starting VALHEIM in 2026 - Beginner Tips
resources.creator: Anabriella
resources.noteEs: Repaso ágil de lo que aprenderías por las malas en las primeras horas. Útil como complemento del video de Kysen, con énfasis en errores comunes que cuestan tiempo o muerte temprana.
resources.noteEn: Snappy review of what you'd learn the hard way in the first hours. Useful as a complement to Kysen's video, with emphasis on common mistakes that cost time or early death.

resources.title: Valheim Starter Guide - The Basics for Beginner's - Building, Combat, Crafting, Skills, Raids Tips
resources.creator: Xaine's World
resources.noteEs: Guía más amplia (16 min) que cubre building básico, combate, crafting, skills y mecánicas de raid. Para quien quiere una vista panorámica de todos los sistemas antes de comprometerse a un mundo.
resources.noteEn: Broader guide (16 min) covering basic building, combat, crafting, skills, and raid mechanics. For someone wanting a panoramic view of every system before committing to a world.

resources.title: A Valheim Beginners Guide - How to Get Started Your First Day of Valheim
resources.creator: JP Valheim
resources.noteEs: Walkthrough del primer día completo (19 min) — JP Valheim camina paso a paso desde el spawn hasta dormir seguro la primera noche. Más detallado que los videos de tips, ideal para quien quiere acompañamiento total.
resources.noteEn: Full first-day walkthrough (19 min) — JP Valheim walks step-by-step from spawn to safely sleeping through the first night. More detailed than tip lists, ideal for someone who wants full hand-holding.
